title: Lake Hillier
subtitle: Why is this lake bright pink?

description:
Lake Hillier, on Middle Island in Western Australia, is bubblegum pink, right next to a deep blue ocean. The color is believed to come from a salt-loving alga.
#LakeHillier #PinkLake #Australia #Geography #EarthDecoded #shorts

segments.text: Why is this lake in Australia as pink as bubblegum?
segments.es: ¿Por qué este lago de Australia es tan rosa como un chicle?

segments.text: This is Lake Hillier, on Middle Island, off the south coast of Western Australia.
segments.es: Este es el lago Hillier, en la isla Middle, frente a la costa sur de Australia Occidental.
segments.headline: MIDDLE ISLAND

segments.text: It's only about six hundred meters long, and a thin strip of sand and forest separates it from the deep blue ocean.
segments.es: Mide solo unos seiscientos metros de largo, y una delgada franja de arena y bosque lo separa del océano azul profundo.

segments.text: The pink color is believed to come from a tiny alga called Dunaliella salina. It makes red pigments to survive in very salty water, and salt-loving bacteria add even more pink.
segments.es: Se cree que el color rosa viene de una pequeña alga llamada Dunaliella salina. Produce pigmentos rojos para sobrevivir en agua muy salada, y unas bacterias que aman la sal le dan aún más rosa.
segments.headline: TINY ALGAE

segments.text: The lake is about as salty as the Dead Sea.
segments.es: El lago es casi tan salado como el mar Muerto.

segments.text: The first written record of it came in 1802, from the British explorer Matthew Flinders.
segments.es: El primer registro escrito del lago es de 1802, del explorador británico Matthew Flinders.

segments.text: And surprisingly, the water is safe to swim in. But the island is remote, so most people only ever see it from a plane.
segments.es: Y sorprendentemente, es seguro nadar en el agua. Pero la isla es remota, así que casi todos solo lo ven desde un avión.

visual.label: but very hard to reach
visual.sub: most see it from the air

segments.text: It's not the only one. Australia has other pink lakes, like Hutt Lagoon on the west coast.
segments.es: No es el único. Australia tiene otros lagos rosas, como Hutt Lagoon en la costa oeste.
segments.headline: MORE PINK LAKES

segments.text: Would you swim in a pink lake? Tell me in the comments.
segments.es: ¿Nadarías en un lago rosa? Dímelo en los comentarios.
